prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1180; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the injured party in connection with the parking lot collision described in the claim you have opened. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already been in contact with our client, please let us know so that we can address it.

We request that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy that covers the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to the incident, including photographs, witness statements, recorded calls, adjuster notes, vehicle data, surveillance footage, and repair estimates. Our client's injuries are serious, and we expect your prompt written response confirming receipt of this letter and the steps your company is taking to preserve the evidence.
